title: Self-Healing Codebase
subtitle: Autonomous surveillance, detection, and correction
autoFix: File a fix card for each regression
autoBisect: Bisect when the last commit is probably not the culprit
cicdDescription: When tests break after a push, an incident is opened with the commit's diff and the failing tests. Its fix is a card on the board: the build codes it and runs QA in a worktree, then waits for your review before its pull request.
autoFixProduction: File a fix card for each production issue
productionDescription: Connect to Sentry, Datadog, CloudWatch, New Relic, or PagerDuty via MCP servers to detect production errors in real-time.
noFragilityData: No fragility data. Run a scan to analyze code risk zones.
